Platform record

  • Meta Quest 3 is the primary supported headset for this preserved release.
  • Meta Quest 2 compatibility is not guaranteed.
  • Standalone VR / Android ASTC.
  • Developer Mode and a Windows PC are required for installation.

Install

  1. Download the complete archive and extract it fully.
  2. Connect a developer-enabled Meta Quest 3 to the PC using USB.
  3. Approve USB debugging inside the headset.
  4. Keep the APK, OBB, installation files and win-x64 folder together.
  5. Run Install_Project_2088_SD-arm64.bat.
  6. Keep the headset connected until installation reports success.
  7. Launch Project 2088 from Unknown Sources.
Installing over another Project 2088 version may replace it. Save-data compatibility between builds is not guaranteed.
